narr: Runoff from heavy rain caused flooding across portions of southern Meade County. Several roads were flooded, with gravel washed off numerous roads.
ev: Runoff from heavy rain inundated several county roads, including Antelope Creek Road, New Underwood Road, Brustel Road, and Elm Springs Road. Crop and pasture land were flooded, as well as low lying areas.
lsr: Antelope Creek Road north of I-90 is under water just south of Elk Creek.
